title: Plan identity attestation provenance
summary: Identity and peer auth work locally, but public attestation needs key provenance and rotation evidence before peers can trust exported identity claims.
expectedFailureModes: Peer identity attestations omit key provenance or rotation context.
Exported identity data exposes local personal identifiers or host-specific paths.
Rotation tests do not bind old and new keys to an auditable subject.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before publishing public identity attestations or peer-auth keys.
nextAction: Design a human-approved public identity attestation publisher only after project key custody, publication location, rotation retention, and revocation disclosure policy are approved.
